title: TIGER WOODS PGA TOUR 09
description:
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 é um videogame esportivo desenvolvido pela EA Tiburon para as versões de PlayStation 3, Wii (intitulado Tiger Woods PGA 09 All Play) e Xbox 360 e pela Exient Entertainment para PlayStation 2 e PlayStation Portablee publicado pela EA Sports para PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Wii e Xbox 360.

Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 recebeu críticas "mistas ou médias" no PlayStation Portable e críticas "geralmente favoráveis" em outras plataformas, de acordo com o agregador de análises Metacritic.
description_en:
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 is a sports video game developed by EA Tiburon for the PlayStation 3, Wii (titled Tiger Woods PGA 09 All Play) and Xbox 360, and by Exient Entertainment for the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable, and published by EA Sports for the PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Wii and Xbox 360.

Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 received "mixed or average" reviews on the PlayStation Portable and "generally favorable" reviews on other platforms, according to review aggregator Metacritic.
description_es:
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 es un videojuego de deportes desarrollado por EA Tiburon para las versiones de PlayStation 3, Wii (titulado Tiger Woods PGA 09 All Play) y Xbox 360 y por Exient Entertainment para PlayStation 2 y PlayStation Portable y publicado por EA Sports para la PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Wii y Xbox 360.

Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 recibió críticas "mixtas o promedio" en PlayStation Portable y críticas "generalmente favorables" en otras plataformas, según el agregador de reseñas Metacritic.
